sentences.text: Additional R&D efforts are concentrated on the enablement of advanced computing, storage, and mobile memory architectures and the investigation of new opportunities that leverage our core semiconductor expertise.

Our main area of focus is on delivering the next generation of processors (CPU and GPU), FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs, accelerators (adaptive, graphics and DPU), SOMs and SmartNICs and associated software.

We focus on designing, with security in mind, new integrated circuits (ICs) with improved performance and performance-per-watt in advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes, the design of logic and interface IP, advanced packaging technologies, and heterogeneous integration technologies.

comparisons.peer_topic: Networking Offerings and Shift to Data Center Computing
comparisons.peer_summary: Networking offerings provide end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet platforms including adapters, cables, DPUs, switches, and software, enabling data center-scale computing where the data center, not just the server, has become the new unit of computing for large AI and HPC workloads.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies address the evolution of computing infrastructure, though with different focal points. MU’s R&D enables advanced computing and storage architectures, while NVDA details how its networking offerings enable data center-scale computing where the data center becomes the new unit of computing for large AI and HPC workloads. Both disclosures reflect a strategic focus on the infrastructure layer (storage/compute vs. networking/interconnect) required for next-generation advanced computing workloads.

sentences.text: Additional R&D efforts are concentrated on the enablement of advanced computing, storage, and mobile memory architectures and the investigation of new opportunities that leverage our core semiconductor expertise.
This has enabled us to architect data center-scale computing platforms that can interconnect thousands of compute nodes with high-performance networking.

While historically the server was the unit of computing, as AI and HPC workloads have become extremely large spanning thousands of compute nodes, the data center has become the new unit of computing, with networking as an integral part.

comparisons.peer_topic: R&D investment scope and diversification targets
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm expects to continue investing in research and development to extend product demand and utilize R&D in industries beyond mobile handsets, such as automotive, IoT, ADAS/AD, and XR, while also focusing on enabling developers to deploy applications across multiple device categories.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and QCOM discuss the diversification of R&D applications beyond their traditional core markets. MU investigates new opportunities leveraging semiconductor expertise (implying expansion beyond just memory), while QCOM explicitly states it utilizes R&D in industries beyond mobile handsets, such as automotive and IoT. Both companies are broadening the scope of their engineering investments to capture new market segments.

sentences.text: Additional R&D efforts are concentrated on the enablement of advanced computing, storage, and mobile memory architectures and the investigation of new opportunities that leverage our core semiconductor expertise.

We expect to continue to invest in research and development in a variety of ways in an effort to extend the demand for our products and technologies and to utilize that research and development in industries and applications beyond mobile handsets (such as automotive and IoT), including continuing the development of new modem and multimedia technologies and other technologies (such as ADAS/AD and XR), developing alternative technologies for certain specialized applications, participating in the formulation of new voice and data communication standards and technologies and assisting in deploying digital voice and data communications networks around the world.
